option_relations.rationale: Viral exanthem is a broad category of skin rash caused by viruses. Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a specific, severe mucocutaneous reaction, not a general viral exanthem.
This option describes a specific type of eruption associated with COVID-19. Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a distinct severe cutaneous adverse reaction, not directly equivalent to this description.
This option describes a varicella-like exanthem related to COVID-19. Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a distinct severe mucocutaneous reaction, not a varicella-like exanthem.

This option describes COVID-19 with cutaneous manifestations, which is a broad category. Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a specific, severe mucocutaneous reaction, not a general cutaneous manifestation of COVID-19.
